description: This script automates creating a firmware upgrade package for Linksys switches, including generating verification scripts, upgrade scripts for NOR and NAND flash, and assembling them into a tar archive.

methods.name: gen_imagecheck
methods.description: Generates a shell script that checks if the provided image matches the hardware model.

methods.name: gen_fwinfo
methods.description: Outputs firmware version and boot version information.

methods.name: gen_nor_upgrade
methods.description: Generates a shell script for upgrading NOR flash, allowing installation of OpenWrt only on the first partition.

methods.name: gen_nand_upgrade
methods.description: Generates a shell script for upgrading NAND flash, allowing installation of OpenWrt only on the first partition.
